_doc: Steinberger validation VOIs. Disks use spherical 15-mm-radius VOIs centred on each disk. Water cylinder uses three nested cylindrical VOIs.

phantom_outline._note: Two small disks in air; phantom outline is just the disks' bounding region. The LOR-perp cut + ROI distance cut do the work.

vois.name: quartz
vois._note: tau_cfg_ns filled from materials/pli_materials.json once the quartz-glass entry exists.
vois.tau_steinberger_note: Clinical-isotope cluster on quartz: 82Rb 1.59 / 68Ga 1.58 / 124I 1.62. Steinberger 22Na headline = 1.538. Takyu certified = 1.56.

vois.name: polycarbonate
vois._note: tau_cfg_ns filled from JSON once entry exists.
vois.tau_steinberger_note: CAVEATED — Steinberger measured polycarbonate only with 22Na, which reads low vs the 2.07 certified reference because of source-laminate self-absorption in his subtraction. EXPECTED RECOVERY near 2.07; treat 1.927 as a caveated cross-check, not a target. Do NOT flag a 2.07-vs-1.927 gap as failure.

phantom_outline._note: Outline is the 20mm-diameter × 30cm water cylinder + small buffer.

vois.name: VOI_15x25
vois._note: 15 mm φ × 25 cm — largest, closest to phantom edge, captures more scatter

oracle._description: EventID-based oracle pairing (M4 pattern): group singles by eventID, accept groups with exactly 2 in 511 + ≥1 in prompt, build truth-position-corrected triples. No randoms subtraction needed; cumulant MLE directly.

clinical._description: M3_tubes pattern: sliding ±2 ns pair sorter + ±5 ns prompt window + +50 ns delayed-window randoms + TOF-corrected τ + truncation-aware MLE.
